{"offer":{"currency":"GBP","fields":{"title":"10 nights in Zanzibar, two coasts on half board","teaser":"Five nights on the cliffs at Mangapwani, five on the sand at Pwani Mchangani","type":"Multi-centre","style":"Beach & resort","country":"Tanzania","region":"Zanzibar","resort":"Mangapwani and Pwani Mchangani","property":"Sea Cliff Resort & Spa Zanzibar and LUX* Marijani Zanzibar","stars":"5 star","board":"Half board","nights":"10","origin":"London Heathrow","airline":"Etihad Airways","flighttype":"Connecting","price":"1700","basis":"per person","badge":"No badge","reference":"HWT-ZNZ-10","protection":"ATOL protected","mapAddress":"Sea Cliff Resort & Spa Zanzibar, Mangapwani, Zanzibar, Tanzania","enquiryEmail":"info@halalworldtravel.com","enquiryPhone":"+44 20 3838 1199","description":"Zanzibar is a small island, but its coasts are not the same as one another, so this trip gives you both. The first five nights are at Sea Cliff Resort & Spa on the north west side at Mangapwani, set on a cliff above the Indian Ocean with infinity pools, the Zuri Rituals spa and the island's only golf course. Stone Town is about twenty five minutes down the road when you want the spice market and the old carved doors.
The second five are at LUX* Marijani on the north east coast at Pwani Mchangani, a smaller place of eighty two rooms with Arab and Swahili touches, an infinity pool and a private stretch of one of the best beaches on the island. Sunrise on that side, sunset back at Sea Cliff, which is a fair reason to take them in that order.
Half board at both hotels covers breakfast and dinner, so the days are yours. Flights are with Etihad Airways from London Heathrow through Abu Dhabi.","itinerary":"Nights 1 to 5, Mangapwani. Sea Cliff Resort & Spa Zanzibar on the north west coast, half board. A cliff top setting above the Indian Ocean, infinity pools, a private beach, horse riding, tennis and Zanzibar's only golf course, with Stone Town around twenty five minutes away.
Nights 6 to 10, Pwani Mchangani. LUX* Marijani Zanzibar on the north east coast, half board. Eighty two rooms, two restaurants, a private beach, an infinity pool and the LUX* ME Spa.","highlights":"Two coasts in one holiday, north west cliffs and north east sand

Zanzibar's only golf course, at Sea Cliff
A private beach at Pwani Mchangani, one of the finest on the island
Etihad Airways from London Heathrow","countryDesc":"Zanzibar lies off the coast of Tanzania in the Indian Ocean, close enough to the equator that the sea stays warm all year round.
